_note: Countries that have single-country plans in Transatel's price grid but appear in none of its zone lists. match-countries.mjs treats them as known countries. They are NOT added to any zone, so they never count as covered by a regional or global plan. Bhutan, DR Congo and Namibia were added when the 24 Nov 2026 grid took them out of Best World: they keep their own single-country plans and pages.
